tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground: full-screen background of the wall display.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, day cells and panels sitting on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, grid lines and empty day cells. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on paper, surface and on every pop colour.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper or surface: times, captions, weekday labels.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Lead pop colour: today marker, primary event fill. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Sky as text or line on paper and surface: links, focus rings, selected outlines.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Pop colour for a second calendar or person, and highlights. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Pop colour for a third calendar or person, and things due soon. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Pop colour for a fourth calendar or person, and done states. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a time and its title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between day cells and stacked events.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen margins and gaps between panels.
